main_text.p: שְׁלָאנָן m. Tranquillissimus, cum epenthesi ל vel est ex שָׁלֵו & שָׁאן ; geminato Nun.
שָׁאַף Haurire, Anhelare, Afpirare: item Absorbere, Deglutire.
שָׁאַר Niphal נִשְׁאַר Reliquum esse, Superesse, Residuum esse vel fieri, Relinqui, Remanere. Hiphil הִשְׁאִיר Reliquit, Reliquum, Residuum fecit.
שְׁאָר m. Reliquus, Residuum, Reliquum, Reliquæ. Chal. שְׁאָר & שְׁאַר Dan.7.7.
שֵׁ֫ר m. Caro, & generaliter Alimentum: item Propinquus Propinqua.
שָׁבִיב m. Scintilla, quasi fragmentum ignis. Chald. שְׁבִיבָא plur. שְׁבִיבִין.
שָׁבָה Captivum cepit, duxit, abduxit, detinuit. Niphal נִשְׁבָּה Captivum abduci.
שְׁבוֹת שְׁבִית, שִׁבָה, שִׁבְיָה f. Idem: plurale, שִׁבְיֹתִים.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and vowel points are approximate; Latin glosses transcribed as legible. The Hebrew line at the foot ("שביה") is a catchword-like isolated word and is placed in the text.
